resolutions.researcher_notes: This unit's segment_name is 'Lockridge Extension Pipeline Project'. BOE Report's republication of Kinder Morgan's own Q3 2020 earnings release states verbatim: 'Construction is complete on NGPL's approximately $51 million Lockridge to Waha Project (KMI's share: $25.5 million), which was placed in service on September 18, 2020.' This confirms StartYear1=2020. Independently, EIA's public 'Natural Gas Pipeline Projects' historical dataset (govt source, downloaded and read directly with openpyxl) carries a row for 'Lockridge Extension Pipeline': Operator 'Nat Gas P L Co of America', Status 'Completed', Completed Date 2020-09-28, Year In Service 2020, Docket 'CP19-52', Miles 16.84, Additional Capacity 500 MMcf/d, Diameter 30in, State TX -- matching the FERC docket for this exact project. Two distinct publishers (Kinder Morgan/BOE Report and EIA) agree on 2020 as the in-service year. I am also including the FERC Federal Register notice of application in Docket CP19-52-000 (document 2019-01654, published 2019-02-08) as supporting context establishing the project's identity, scope (16.84-mile, 30-inch extension of NGPL's Lockridge Pipeline in Ward, Reeves and Pecos Counties, TX, to a new interconnect with Trans-Pecos Pipeline at the Waha Hub, cost ~$51,611,669) and docket number, which matches EIA's docket field exactly -- though this document alone does not state the in-service date, so it is offered as corroborating identity/scope, not as one of the two agreeing sources for the date itself. CONCERN (informational, resolved -- not affecting the value): the row's wiki page cites federalregister.gov/documents/2019/12/03/2019-26078 as a source for this project; I fetched its full text and it is NOT about Gulf Coast Southbound/Lockridge at all -- it is a 'Notice of Request Under Blanket Authorization' for the unrelated '134th Street Lateral Project' in Cook County, Illinois and Lake County, Indiana, filed by the same company (Natural Gas Pipeline Company of America LLC) under a different docket. I did not propose this URL. I separately located and read the correct Federal Register document for this project via the API's keyword search on 'Lockridge pipeline' (document 2019-01654, docket CP19-52-000), which I have used above instead. I also checked the wiki's RBN Energy seed citation (rbnenergy.com/node/11661) via its Wayback capture (live origin 403s) and confirmed it describes a DIFFERENT project -- 'NGPL Gulf Coast Southbound Expansion Phase II', in-service Q2/2021, 460+300=760 MMcf/d Chicago-to-Agua Dulce -- not usable for this Lockridge/2020 unit; not proposed.
